title: Provide option for system tray icon to show normal status on machines that are not expected to have internet access
line: A new "Warn when the network has no Internet access" option in the network configuration lets the tray icon stay normal and stops the Limited Connectivity notification on networks without Internet.
explanation: When NetworkManager's connectivity check reports Limited, plasma-nm always adds the warning badge to the tray icon and kded shows a "Limited Connectivity" notification after 10 seconds. On machines that sit on an isolated LAN on purpose this is a permanent false alarm, and there was no way to turn it off short of disabling NetworkManager's connectivity check system-wide. The change adds a per-user "Warn when the network has no Internet access" checkbox (default on, key LimitedConnectivityWarningEnabled in plasma-nm's General group) to the network KCM's Configuration dialog; when it is off the tray icon ignores Limited connectivity and kded skips the notification. Captive portals are still flagged, since those need the user to log in.

commits.message:
applet: add an option to not warn about missing Internet access

On machines whose network is not meant to reach the Internet, the tray
icon always showed the limited connectivity badge and a notification. A
new option in the General configuration section turns both of them off.

BUG: 426643

media.caption: Master on a fake wired LAN with Limited connectivity: warning badge on the tray icon and a Limited Connectivity notification
Same LAN with the new option unchecked: the tray icon switches to the normal wired icon right after pressing OK
Master: the Configuration dialog of Wi-Fi & Networking has no such option
New "Warn when the network has no Internet access" checkbox in the General section (unchecked here)
